result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and dedicated signals, despite being in a mixed-use area. The presence of embedded rails and degraded pavement creates significant tripping hazards and complicates navigation for those with mobility aids.

hazards.description: Streetcar tracks embedded in the asphalt create a significant tripping hazard and can catch bicycle wheels.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: No designated crossing area for pedestrians at a signalized intersection, leading to unpredictable crossing behavior.

hazards.name: Poor pavement condition

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or zebra-striped crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian countdown signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated signals to inform pedestrians when it is safe to cross and how much time remains.

result.summary: This is a complex, multi-leg intersection featuring trolley tracks and significant asphalt expanse, which increases pedestrian exposure. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the wide crossing distances and faded markings create a challenging environment for non-motorized users.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded rail tracks create tripping hazards for pedestrians and can be slippery, especially when wet.
hazards.location_in_image: Running through the center and foreground of the intersection

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The large, open intersection requires pedestrians to spend significant time exposed to traffic without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: The main crossing area between the corner with the bus and the opposite side

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are worn and lack high visibility, reducing driver awareness of the crossing zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Visible on the left side of the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to improve visibility for approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at corners to reduce crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the wide crossing to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.

result.summary: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals despite the presence of a curb ramp with tactile paving. The environment is characterized by a blind corner created by the building's proximity to the street and the presence of embedded trolley tracks in the roadway.
